estimators.label: Crude (unadjusted)
estimators.note: Unadjusted — sicker patients were channeled to one drug, and that confounding hides the harm.

estimators.label: Propensity-score matched
estimators.note: Groups balanced on measured confounders — the harm the crude estimate buried now emerges.

estimators.label: Self-controlled case series
estimators.note: Each patient is their own control — a method with different blind spots independently agrees.
